assertions.name: n-independence: L_2..L_5 agree between minimal-n and ambient n=15 below the 128-bit floor
recursion reproduces the 26-subset full Mobius at k = 2..5 below the 128-bit floor
reconstruction: sum_k C(6,k) c_k = L_6 (the recursion read backwards)
signs at k = 2..5 are + - - +, as at A = 5

description: The size-only cumulant recursion c_k = L_k - sum_{j<k} C(k,j) c_j (Lean: QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.cum_eq_sizeCum), valid for exchangeable systems, combined with n-independence of L_S, reaches order six with five minimal-system trace pairs instead of 57 ambient n=18 traces. Re-derives everything from the committed 128-bit A=6 sidecar and cross-checks L_2..L_5 and c_2..c_5 against the independent 200-bit A=5 ambient run. Reports the first order-six cumulant of the homonuclear bond model.
caveats: Exchangeable (homonuclear) case only. The recursion does not apply to 6He (pnpnnn), whose cumulants need the full lattice: 57 traces at n=18, out of exact reach. One order-six datum, in the one system where the recursion is a theorem.

L_6 is a 128-bit (about 38-digit) MPFR value from a detached run; L_2..L_5 in the same sidecar are 128-bit too. Cross-checks against the 200-bit A=5 run are therefore floored at ~1e-35, and that is the floor the checks use. The physical ceiling is Q_ERR ~ 1e-12 regardless.
One more term does not settle convergence. The A=5 twelve-ordering sweep showed |c_5/c_4| straddling 1 across orderings; the value reported here is one ordering-free (exchangeable) number at k=6.
